## Finding

**Yes.** The supplied records show one cost event for manufacturing order **MO-25-09-1070** at Modine’s Racine operation, created **145 minutes after** the September cost period entered Pending Close.

| Item | Recorded value |
|---|---|
| Work order | **WO-2025-09-004** / **MO-25-09-1070** |
| Product | Cooler Plate Pack |
| Source transaction | **TXN-ISSUE-250930-1070** |
| Cost event | **CE-250904-0004** |
| Event type | **INPUT** — component issue |
| Amount | **USD $318,250.75** (**31,825,075 cents**) |
| Cost period | **Sep-25** / **PER-COST-2025-09** |
| Event-created time | **2025-09-30T20:25:00** |
| Pending Close time | **2025-09-30T18:00:00** |
| Recorded accounting status | **POSTED** |

**Timing calculation:**  
`2025-09-30T20:25:00 − 2025-09-30T18:00:00 = 2 hours 25 minutes = 145 minutes`

The timestamps above are reproduced exactly from the source; no timezone or UTC offset was supplied.

## Policy assessment

**The recorded `POSTED` status is not consistent with Oracle’s documented Pending Close treatment for this newly created transaction.**

Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM Cost Management 26B, **“Cost Accounting Period Statuses and Transaction Accounting,” printed page 225 / PDF page 233**, states:

> “Transactions created after the pending close date, even if they relate to a current or prior period, won't be processed.”

The documentation also says new transactions falling in or before the Pending Close period are not staged in Cost Accounting or Receipt Accounting until the period is closed or reopened. Revenue lines, COGS recognition, and manual cost adjustments are exceptions; this **INPUT/component-issue event is not one of those exceptions**.

The source records show September still in **PENDING_CLOSE**. Accordingly, the event’s recorded **POSTED** status is an exception to the supplied policy.

**Sources:** `system/oracle_scm_cost_management/state.db` — `work_orders`, `cost_periods`, and `work_order_cost_events`; the Oracle policy excerpt cited above.

The review was read-only; **no database records were changed**. The audit result and provenance were saved to `/cache/work/worker_b6b4b8cc5fe5/audit-report.json`.
